scope: Four individual Level 3 1990s mall maintenance-wing concepts. Images only; no Blender or Studio implementation.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Individual polished 3D environment concept for a modular Blender-built Roblox horror game Level 3.
Primary request: A beautiful, believable late-1990s shopping mall HVAC maintenance room after hours, compact industrial utility room, one complete scene. Hero asset is a galvanized air handling unit against the left wall with replaceable filter housing; a broad rectangular galvanized duct runs along wall and ceiling, keeping head clearance over the central route. A modest organized pipe cluster with old valves and round gauges, a leaning service ladder, an open brown-orange service door revealing an angled side hallway on the rear-right. Clean central walking route. Selected chunky props, lovely industrial material contrast, restrained wear.
Art direction: grounded nostalgic mall service wing, subtle liminal unease; beige painted block walls with faded mint-teal waist-height band, off-white low commercial ceiling, dry grey utility tile. Careful high-end Blender game-environment render, tactile painted metal, brushed galvanized seams, rubber seals, believable proportions, modular construction rather than excessive tiny clutter.
Composition: human eye-height 28mm architectural camera from entry corner, wide landscape 1536x1024 approximately, asymmetric layered composition, clear foreground path, readable exit. One full image, no collage or captions.
Lighting: cool soft fluorescent practicals, a warmer gentle glow from the open door, visually rich bounced light and readable shadows. Beautiful subtle speculars, floor visibly dry and mostly matte.
Avoid: people, monsters, gore, water, puddles, aquariums, fountains, neon sci-fi, holograms, pitch-black shadows, fog, extreme ruin, giant power plant scale, logos, watermark, borders, labels.
assets.visual_review: Visually inspected the generated image: compact beige/mint mall utility room, strong galvanized air-handler and overhead duct, valves/gauges/ladder, legible orange doorway into side hall, dry unobstructed central route. Restrained wear, readable lighting, no people/water/sci-fi. Accept as concept; practical path/collision and polygon budgets not established by image.

The hero prop is a chunky removed escalator motor with visible ribbed metal housing and pulley on a low pallet, placed along the right wall beside a tidy teal tool trolley. A brown-orange service door at the rear leads toward a quiet shadowed storage passage. Spacious clear centre floor and a continuous walking route.
Art direction: polished high-end Blender environment art, grounded industrial everyday 1990s nostalgia, subtle liminal unease, tactile materials. Beige painted block walls with faded mint-teal waist-height band, off-white commercial panel ceiling, grey dry linoleum floor, restrained wear. Modular, chunky forms suitable for a reusable game asset kit; selected well-designed props rather than a wall of junk.
Composition: asymmetric human-eye 28mm architectural view across the workshop, wide landscape about 1536x1024, foreground space, workshop detail on sides, readable service exit. One full image, no collage.
Lighting: a warm tungsten task lamp grazing the wooden bench, cool gentle mint-tinted fluorescent ceiling light, appealing soft bounced light, subtle shadows never pitch black. Beautiful contrast of warm wood, painted cabinets and ribbed industrial iron.
Avoid: people, monsters, gore, water, puddles, aquariums, fountains, neon sci-fi, holograms, fog, extreme ruin, giant factory scale, logos, watermark, captions, borders.
assets.visual_review: Visually inspected generated image: cohesive beige/mint caretaker workshop, warm workbench lamp and cool overhead fluorescence, pegboard/vise/parts drawers, strong ribbed motor on pallet and teal trolley, visible rear storage doorway. Centre route clear. Dry linoleum has pronounced specular finish but no water/puddles. Small wall charts contain incidental unreadable text. Accept as environment concept, not production geometry.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Individual polished 3D environment concept for a modular Blender-built Roblox horror game Level 3.
Primary request: A beautifully art-directed compact late-1990s shopping mall signage and seasonal-decoration storage room after hours. A through-room with TWO visibly usable orange-brown service doorways at opposite ends of its long wall axis: show a close partly visible open doorway at left foreground, and a complete open doorway at far back-right, connected by a spacious uncluttered centre route.
Hero assets: large obsolete geometric 1990s mall wayfinding panels with pastel teal and burgundy arrow motifs leaning securely in a purpose-made rack along the left wall. Simple arrows and color blocks, no need for readable words. Along the right wall tidy tall but not dense metal racking with organised brown cartons, several folded chairs and rolled carpet. A small controlled cluster of stored festive star decorations and a modest artificial plant gives this useful room distinctive nostalgic identity. Do not fill every shelf.
Art direction: exquisite polished Blender game-environment render, tactile material surfaces, subtle liminal unease, everyday believable mall back-of-house. Beige painted block walls with faded mint-teal waistband, off-white low commercial ceiling panels, dry grey utility tile, slightly aged yet maintained paint and cardboard. Chunky modular geometry, reusable props, no excessive tiny clutter.
Composition: person-eye 28mm wide architectural camera looking diagonally down the storage aisle, landscape roughly 1536x1024, one complete full scene, no collage. Framing must make both access openings readable, floor mostly open. A calm purposeful asymmetrical layout with a strong perspective towards the exit.
Lighting: attractive side fluorescent streaks across racking, soft bounced cool-white overhead light, gentle warm corridor glow through doors. Rich readable shadows, dry surfaces, no atmospheric fog.
Avoid: people, monsters, gore, water, puddles, aquariums, fountains, neon sci-fi, holograms, pitch-black areas, extreme ruin, packed clutter maze, logos, watermark, captions, borders.
assets.visual_review: Visually inspected generated image: distinctive teal/burgundy arrow-panel rack, folded chairs, rolls, organised boxes, restrained festive stars and artificial foliage. Two usable-looking open doors visible at near left and far end, with unobstructed centre aisle. Beige/mint continuity and readable lighting. Racking denser than requested but orderly and no clutter on route; acceptable concept. Dry tile is glossy, no water.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Individual polished 3D environment concept for a modular Blender-built Roblox horror game Level 3.
Primary request: A beautiful compact cozy-eerie late-1990s shopping mall PA and CCTV control room after hours, one full scene. Main hero object is a bank of six chunky beige CRT surveillance monitors arranged neatly on an uncluttered L-shaped laminate worktop against the left and back walls; every screen shows a different grainy empty mall corridor or staircase, soft muted cyan monochrome. A short black rack holds VHS video decks, cassette PA amplifier and analog meters. Beige corded telephone on desk, telephone patch panel on wall with organised short cables, a single rolling office chair tucked to one side. A mint painted service door clearly visible at right, open slightly toward the hallway. Spacious accessible centre floor.
Art direction: exquisite tactile Blender game-environment render with believable everyday 1990s office-electronics proportions; grounded nostalgic mall maintenance wing, quiet liminal unease. Beige painted block walls with faded mint-teal lower band, off-white low acoustic-tile ceiling, dry matte grey linoleum, brown-orange door frame. Restrained wear and softly yellowed plastics. Modular chunky shapes appropriate for a practical Blender/Roblox kit rather than thousands of tiny clutter props.
Composition: person-eye 28mm camera from opposite corner looking across L desk towards mint service door, wide landscape roughly 1536x1024, strong calm asymmetry, one full image no collage. Keep the view of floor and exit readable.
Lighting: dim but fully readable cool fluorescent ambience, soft cyan CRT spill on worktop balanced against a warm old desk lamp. Lovely plastic/metal/laminate material separation, no harsh bloom or fog. Cozy practical light with subtle unsettling emptiness.
Avoid: people, monsters, gore, water, puddles, aquariums, fountains, sci-fi command centre, modern flat-screen displays, neon strips, holograms, pitch-black shadows, extreme ruin, logos, watermark, captions, borders.
assets.visual_review: Visually inspected generated image: six chunky beige CRTs showing empty mall views, VHS/analog PA rack, corded phone and patch panel, L desk, chair at left, readable mint door and clear centre floor. Warm task lighting balanced with cyan monitor images, cohesive beige/mint service-wing palette. Incidental generated notices include legible invented mall slogans; these were not requested and should not be treated as final in-game signage. No people/monsters/water or modern screens. Accept as concept.
